free_tier.stated: $5 free every month; save a card, charged nothing, and the first $5 of each month's use is free: 370 tiny hours, 185 small hours, or 11,100 CI minutes on small, or any mix. It starts again each month on the day you signed up.
free_tier.notes: Recurring monthly credit, denominated in dollars of usage and metered by the running second. The rate card: tiny 1 vCPU / 2 GiB / 20 GiB at $0.0135/hour standard and $0.00675/hour spot; small 2 vCPU / 4 GiB / 40 GiB at $0.027/hour standard; medium 4 vCPU / 8 GiB / 80 GiB at $0.054/hour; large 8 vCPU / 16 GiB / 160 GiB at $0.108/hour.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a whole Linux virtual machine with its own kernel, not a stored object
per_object_cap.notes: Each sandbox has a full disk: tiny 20 GiB, small 40 GiB, medium 80 GiB, large 160 GiB.

retention.stated: Stop a sandbox and it keeps its files and running programs, free for 14 days. After that, $0.05 a GB a month, until you delete it. A sandbox whose time limit runs out is deleted, unless you ask to keep it.

egress.terms: Outbound traffic is open by default: a sandbox can reach the whole internet unless its template's rule says otherwise, with open, blocked or IPv4 allowlist rules enforced outside the VM. A sandbox can register 5 public ports (HTTP and WebSocket) reachable by anyone with the link while it runs. No per-GB egress price is published; email is priced at $0.50 per 1,000 messages.
egress.free_allowance: no per-GB egress allowance stated; outbound is open by default and public ports are included

interface_detail: Plain HTTP and JSON at https://agental.io/v1; a CLI, MCP server and agent skills; SSH, a terminal and a desktop with a screen; public URLs for published ports. OAuth sign-in through the browser for ChatGPT and other MCP apps.
tooling: REST API with a bearer API key, `npx agental@latest` onboarding, an `agental` CLI, TypeScript and Python SDKs, an MCP server, Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / opencode integrations and Docker inside the sandbox.
chaining: A whole Linux VM reachable by REST, SSH and a browser, with a full disk kept after stop, can be paired with object-storage records for durable state; outbound allowlists and private public-port gating let it call other records' endpoints without exposing keys.

limits.value: $5 of included use per month (370 tiny hours, 185 small hours or 11,100 CI minutes on small), billed by the second at the per-size rates
4 units running at once on Free, two small sandboxes; 40 units after the first top-up. Free starts: 120 per 15 minutes.
stopped sandboxes keep files free for 14 days, then $0.05 a GB a month; 10 snapshots free, then $1.70 a month each

limits_note: Spot sandboxes run at half rate in spare room, are not counted in the running limit and can be taken back; a spot run lasts at most 24 hours. A sandbox can register 5 public ports; time limits up to 86400 seconds (24 hours). Preview analytics keep figures at most 7 days. Sign-up currently takes an invite.
binding_note: The $5 monthly usage allowance runs out first at the published per-hour rates, before the running-count and retention limits; the card is charged nothing until top-ups.

identity_cost.detail: The signup page states 'Sign up, save a card (charged $0) for $5 of free use every month'. The onboarding page adds 'Sign-up takes an invite for now: ask for one on X.' Browser OAuth sign-in is used for MCP clients.

reliability_note: Spot sandboxes are stopped with their disk kept or deleted when a standard sandbox needs the room; a stopped sandbox is free 14 days then billed for storage, and its files are deleted after credits run out unless topped up. Sandboxes older than a time limit are deleted with their disk unless configured to stop.
confidence_note: All rates, the free allowance, concurrency, retention, identity gate and egress posture are quoted from the vendor's own pricing, signup, onboarding and docs pages captured 2026-11-24.
